votes.motion: Approve the Work Session minutes from March 2, 2021 and Formal Meeting Minutes from March 2, 2021, March 16, 2021 and January 4, 2022.
votes.description: Approves the official minutes from four prior Council meetings spanning March 2021 and January 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 3 of 2022, adopting a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall celebrating the 20th anniversary of the 2002 Winter Olympic Games, and expressing the City's support and goals for hosting a future games beneficial to the community.
votes.description: Adopts a ceremonial resolution jointly with the Mayor marking the 20th anniversary of the 2002 Winter Olympics and stating the City's support for hosting a future Olympic Games.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the ordinance requiring notice for permits to work in the public way.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance that would require adjacent property owners to be notified of work being performed in the public right-of-way, deferring final action to a later meeting.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates for budget amendment No. 6, Art Barn public benefits resolution, two rezones, and a second rezone; approving Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 4) for FY2021-22; and approving board appointments of Richard Taylor and Ayanna Allen to the Arts Council Board.
